questions.question: On the price board's newest day for each hub, which hub had the highest day-ahead daily mean, and what was it in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: Among the hubs the board can show, SPP North Hub (spp:SPPNORTH_HUB) had the highest day-ahead daily mean: 51.7155 USD/MWh (price_board_latest, derived). Its newest day is 2026-11-06 (UTC date label). The next highest was CAISO TH_NP15_GEN-APND at 51.3024 USD/MWh (price_board_latest). The board ranks 11 hubs across CAISO, ERCOT and SPP. NYISO and ISO-NE rows are held for a license ("license needed"). MISO is paused while terms are reviewed. I state no figures for those three, so the ranking covers only the public hubs.

questions.question: What moved most on the price board: which hub's day-ahead daily mean changed most, in percent, on its newest day against the day before, and by how much?
questions.answer: ERCOT HB_WEST had the largest day-ahead move on the price board. Its day-ahead daily mean rose 132.19 percent on its newest day, 2026-11-06 (UTC date label). That is up from 19.39 USD/MWh on 2026-11-05 to 45.01 USD/MWh on 2026-11-06, a change of 25.63 USD/MWh (price_board_latest, derived). The next largest moves were SPPNORTH_HUB at 82.96 percent and ERCOT HB_NORTH at 79.56 percent (price_board_latest). The figures are means of complete local operating days.

questions.question: Where is the spark spread widest on the price board (each hub's newest day, at the board's stated heat rate), and what is it in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: SPP North hub (spp:SPPNORTH_HUB) has the widest spark spread on the price board. On its newest day, 2026-11-06 (UTC operating-day label), it is 33.31 USD/MWh (33.3055, price_board_spreads). The board defines the spread as the day-ahead daily mean minus an assumed 7.0 MMBtu/MWh heat rate times Henry Hub. The 7.0 is an assumption, not a measured heat rate. For SPP North the day-ahead daily mean is 51.72 USD/MWh and the Henry Hub spot used is 2.63 USD/MMBtu, dated 2026-11-03 (all price_board_spreads). Next are CAISO SP15 (caiso:TH_SP15_GEN-APND) at 25.33 USD/MWh and ERCOT HB_HUBAVG at 22.23 USD/MWh, both for 2026-11-06 (price_board_spreads). The table is derived (computed by the ERW from other tables) and public.

questions.question: On the price board, which hub's day-ahead price ran furthest from real time (day-ahead minus real time, either sign) on its newest day, and by how much in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: On the price board (price_board_latest, derived), ERCOT's HB_WEST had the widest gap between day-ahead and real time on its newest day. Its day-ahead minus real-time mean was 16.44 USD/MWh (16.4397), so day-ahead was above real time. The day is 2026-11-04, a complete local operating day, with the date taken at 00:00Z. The next-widest were ERCOT HB_SOUTH at 15.28 USD/MWh and ERCOT HB_HUBAVG at 14.77 USD/MWh. The widest gap with real time above day-ahead was SPP's SPPNORTH_HUB at -9.02 USD/MWh, on 2026-10-31. The board ranked 11 hubs: the 6 ERCOT hubs, 2 SPP hubs and 3 CAISO hubs. Hubs whose rows are held for a license are not in the table.
